$comment: Documentation defects that exist today, recorded so the parity suite can be green
while they are fixed in order. Each stage of the audit DELETES entries from here,
which is what makes that stage's assertion mechanical rather than a judgement call.
An empty array in every list means the audit is done. Never add an entry to make a
test pass without a line in `why` saying what is wrong and which stage removes it.

egressAllowlist.$comment: Hosts found in src/ that do NOT need a privacy disclosure, each with the reason.

permanent.github.com: Link to the source repository, in the privacy notice's own prose.
permanent.owncloud.org: XML namespace URI in a WebDAV request body, never resolved.
permanent.ai.example.ch: Placeholder endpoint in a unit test fixture.
permanent.ollama.local: Placeholder endpoint in a unit test fixture.
permanent.api.openai.com: Example base URL shown in the AI connection form; the user supplies their own.
permanent.cloud.example.com: Placeholder in the Nextcloud setup form.
permanent.lovable.dev: postMessage target in preview-auth plumbing, gated on running inside a Lovable editor iframe. Not a fetch, never active in production. Dead scaffolding to remove, not egress to disclose.
permanent.cash-flow-jm.lovable.app: Stale server URL declared in the OpenAPI spec, not a host we contact. The banned-phrase check on `lovable.app` forces its removal in stage 7; delete this entry with it.

undisclosed.$comment: REAL third parties that privacy.tsx does not yet mention. Stage 1 empties this.
undisclosed.nominatim.openstreetmap.org: Server-side geocoding; receives search text and exact coordinates.
undisclosed.tile.openstreetmap.org: Browser-side map tiles; receives the reader's own IP.
undisclosed.unpkg.com: Browser-side Swagger UI assets; receives the reader's IP and can execute JS.
undisclosed.www.openstreetmap.org: Click-out link carrying coordinates in the URL.
undisclosed.api.frankfurter.dev: Browser-side FX rates on the dashboard, /envelopes and /add; receives the reader's IP on page load.
Open Graph image URL left over from Lovable; fetched by social crawlers, not users. Should be self-hosted or dropped.

bannedPhrases.$comment: Phrases that must not appear once the audit is done. Stage 2 empties most of this.

pending.X-API-Token: No route reads this header; every one reads `authorization`. Stage 5.
pending.lovable.app: Stale production server URL in openapi-spec.ts. Stage 7.
pending.Book as loss: Not the UI's wording; the app says write off / Abschreiben. Stage 2.
pending.Als Verlust buchen: Not the UI's wording, German. Stage 2.

localeParity.$comment: Known DE/EN content divergences. Stage 3 empties this.

blockCountMismatch.why: EN has an 'Opening balance sign' block with no German counterpart. It carries no heading, so anchor checks pass. Stage 3.
EN lists statement reading among the assistant's abilities; DE omits it. Stage 3.
DE carries a lede paragraph that EN folded into the frontmatter description. Cosmetic; Stage 3 aligns it.

badDescriptions.$comment: Machine-generated frontmatter descriptions that read as colon-joined heading lists or end mid-word. These ship into <meta>, OG images, the sidebar, the Orama index and llms.txt. Stage 3.

aiActionsUndocumented.$comment: AI_ACTIONS ids with no prose on the help site. Stage 8 empties this.

openApiUndocumentedRoutes.$comment: Routes that exist but are deliberately absent from the spec.

permanent./api/public/version: Build stamp, not part of the data API.

metricsUndocumented.$comment: Metric series not named in README section 6. Stage 8 empties this.

blumeAuditBaseline.$comment: Recorded so the one standing warning is not normalised into invisibility.
blumeAuditBaseline.warningDetail: 'Orphan page /en' — a false positive: the English index is reachable through the language switcher, which the link auditor cannot follow.
